'''Alex Phillips''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Normal)]] on 24 June 2000 with Death Star II sealed, according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d930">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-ds2-pre-release-normal-ill-6-24-99d930/ ds2-pre-release-normal-ill-6-24-99], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-ds2-pre-release-normal-ill-6-24-99d930/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
